eligibility.evidence: Sec 3-5, Tables 1-2: GPT-4 and GPT-4V solve ConceptARC analogy/abstraction puzzles, compared with MTurk/Prolific human accuracy from Moskvichev et al. (cited human study, Sec 3). Borderline because ARC is an AI benchmark, though built on core-knowledge concepts with human data.

A.title: Comparing Humans, GPT-4, and GPT-4V On Abstraction and Reasoning Tasks

models.name: GPT-4 (text-only)
models.query_date: November 2023 (version available in November 2023, footnote 1 p.4)

models.name: GPT-4V
models.version: gpt4-vision-preview (one-shot, API); web application version not stated (zero-shot)

paradigms.name: ConceptARC abstraction and analogy puzzles, text grids, all 480 tasks

D.population: MTurk and Prolific participants from Moskvichev et al. 2023 (12 excluded by attention checks); minimal-task accuracy re-derived by the authors from that dataset

effects.label: BELOW-HUMAN
effects.location: Table 1 p.5 (overall 0.33 at temperature 0 and 0.5 vs humans 0.91; temperatures pooled); text GPT-4 on minimal tasks 0.69/0.65 vs 0.95, Table 2 p.5

effects.label: BELOW-HUMAN
effects.location: Table 2 p.5 (zero-shot 0.25, one-shot 0.23 vs humans 0.95; pooled across prompt variants)

E.headline: Neither GPT-4 nor GPT-4V shows humanlike abstraction: one-shot prompting lifts GPT-4 to 0.33 versus 0.91 for humans; GPT-4V is worse.

G.notes: No inferential statistics or intervals; single run per task, up to three guesses. GPT-4V zero-shot used the web app (version and temperature unknown) while one-shot used the API, confounding shot count with platform. Human minimal-task accuracy re-derived from earlier dataset by co-author.
